WITH ariel AS (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating AS rating
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
  ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
paulin AS (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating AS rating
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
  ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((ariel.rating - paulin.rating) * 100.0 / paulin.rating) AS percentage_higher
FROM ariel, paulin;

FINAL("WITH annual AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    ym.CustomerID,
    SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS ym
  JOIN customers AS c
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_annual_consumption
  FROM annual
  GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
  SELECT
    a.Segment,
    AVG(a.annual_consumption) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM annual AS a
  JOIN segment_min AS m
    ON a.Segment = m.Segment
   AND a.annual_consumption = m.min_annual_consumption
  GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference_sme_lam,
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS difference_lam_kam,
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS difference_kam_sme;")

  FROM finishers
  ORDER BY positionOrder ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
last AS (
  SELECT milliseconds AS last_ms
  FROM finishers
  ORDER BY positionOrder DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

FROM champion, last;
""")

db.execute("""
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    r.year AS year,
    CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) AS hours,
    substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1) AS rest
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN races AS r
    ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year < 1975
    AND res.positionOrder = 1
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
seconds AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    hours * 3600
      + CAST(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
      + CAST(substr(rest, instr(rest, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS total_seconds
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT
  year,
  AVG(total_seconds) AS average_time_seconds
FROM seconds
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;
""")

QUESTION: What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal uric acid counts?
HINT (use these definitions exactly):
  male refers to SEX = 'M'; female refers to SEX = 'F'; abnormal uric acid refers to UA < = '8.0' where SEX = 'M', UA < = '6.5' where SEX = 'F'; calculation = DIVIDE(SUM(UA <= '8.0' and SEX = 'M'), SUM(UA <= '6.5 and SEX = 'F'))

SIMILAR SOLVED EXAMPLES (different databases — copy the SQL *style* and output-column conventions, not the table names):

  Q: How many male patients are diagnosed with hypertension as compared to female patients?
  Hint: male refers to gender = 'M'; diagnosed with hypertension refers to conditions.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension'; female refers to gender = 'F'; number of male patients with hypertension = count(patient WHERE gender = 'M' AND conditions.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension'); number of female patients with hypertension = count(patient WHERE gender = 'F' AND conditions.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension');
  SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'M' THEN T2.patient END) AS Male , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'F' THEN T2.patient END) AS Female FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension'
